OtherNames: Hera LNG Import Terminal; Timor GAP LNG Import Terminal
Location: Hera Metinaro, approx. 12 km east of Dili Port
PowerPlantsSupplied: Hera power plant; Betano power plant; Inur-Sakato (Oecusse) power plant
ResearcherNotesProject: Domestic LNG import terminal proposed by state oil company TIMOR GAP E.P. to supply gas-converted power plants (Hera, Betano, Oecusse), replacing diesel. Wood Group Kenny Sdn Bhd completed pre-feasibility/feasibility studies and in Feb 2022 selected Hera Metinaro (~12 km from Dili Port) as the site, after evaluating Betano and Oecusse. Three concepts recommended for further study: (1) ssFSRU + trestle jetty + onshore station; (2) converted FSRU + subsea pipeline + onshore station; (3) trestle jetty + onshore LNG storage and regasification. Leading concept is floating (ssFSRU/converted FSRU), hence Floating=yes/Offshore=yes pending concept selection. Threshold met: sponsor identified (TIMOR GAP), site selected (Hera Metinaro), concrete step (feasibility study completed + site selection Feb 2022). DISTINCT from GEM's existing 'Sunrise FLNG Terminal' (T100000130342), which is the Greater Sunrise EXPORT project (a.k.a. Beaco LNG) — this is a separate domestic IMPORT terminal. No FID; latest concrete activity 2022, but ICIS (Jul 2025) reports continued interest tied to ASEAN accession. Capacity/units left blank (no firm public figure for the import terminal). FSRU concept leading but no specific vessel chartered/named yet, so FSRU sync is moot (no vessel name/IMO to link).
